bullets.text: A gym trainer in Chennai was arrested for stalking and threatening a female software firm owner, and the office should monitor public safety.

stories.title: Gym trainer arrested for stalking, threatening woman
takeaways: A 36-year-old gym trainer was arrested in Chennai for stalking a software firm owner.
Police action was initiated following formal complaints regarding harassment and threats.
stories.snippet: Gym trainer arrested for stalking, threatening woman Chennai: A 36-year-old gym trainer was arrested here for allegedly stalking, harassing, and threatening a woman who runs a private software firm, police said on…
